description: Airport code lookup: IATA and ICAO airport codes with airport name, city, region, country, latitude and longitude, elevation and IANA time zone for 1,985 airports in all 54 African countries, India and South Asia, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. iata.description: 3-letter IATA airport code, e.g. NBO, LOS, DEL
